strategic_initiatives: Strategic Positioning The Company continues to advance its transformation agenda across operational efficiency, diversification, digital integration, and sustainability alignment.

In line with Oman Vision 2040 and the national energy transition strategy, Galfar is selectively expanding its capabilities in high-voltage substations, renewable energy projects, environmental infrastructure, and PPP delivery frameworks.
The Company remains committed to investing in workforce development, leadership programs, and digital HR systems to support organizational resilience and long-term growth.
Management will continue to emphasize disciplined capital allocation, margin optimization, operational efficiency, and digital integration as key drivers of long-term competitiveness.

The Company continues to strengthen its enterprise risk management framework through enhanced tender-stage risk assessments, structured bid review processes, and digital cost validation tools to support disciplined project selection and balanced contractual risk allocation.
